text.en:
The sum of twelve thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, is hereby
appropraited, out of any funds in the Insular treasury not otherwise appropriated, to be expended for the
construction, maintenance, and repair of a trail to be known as Mount Data-Sabangan Trail from
approximately kilometer ninety-six, Mountain Trail, to Sabangan, suprovince of Lepanto.

This Acct shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, April 3, 1915
